column1: # mapping_set_title: SWAT4HCLS BioHackathon 2025: SemBeacon to GA4GH VRS

# mapping_set_description: Mappings declared during the SWAT4HCLS 2025 BioHackathon between the SemBeacon genomic-variants schema (built on SO, GENO, SIO and FALDO) and the GA4GH Variation Representation Specification. Transcribed from the project's curation spreadsheet; see mappings/README.md for the normalisations applied.

# comment: The source sheet's last block (faldo:location, faldo:begin, faldo:end, faldo:position, geno:0000382, geno:0000207, sio:000300) was left incomplete during curation: it has no predicate or no object. Those rows are recorded in mappings/bh25/UNRESOLVED.md rather than asserted here. The curators worked against GA4GH VRS 1.2/1.3, so objects use the vrs1: prefix (VRS 1.3). Several targets here -- Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Residue, Feature, Gene, UtilityVariation -- were removed in VRS 2.0, which is the version vcf-core itself targets. See mappings/vcf-core-alignments.sssom.tsv for the vcf-core to VRS 2.0 spoke. Transcription verified against the source sheet on 2026-09-08: subject, predicate and object of every row match after the normalisations noted above.

column8: Curators compared allele definitions across ISOGG, SO (SO:0001023 allele, SO:0001059 sequence_alteration, SO:0001060 sequence_variant), Wikipedia and GENO:0000512 before settling on closeMatch.
Haplotype is out of scope for SemBeacon, which does not represent variants at the individual level, but zygosity is still represented; unknown zygosity is acceptable.

Curators noted that biologists use location or locus at widely varying precision, from numeric start and end coordinates to named genomic features standing in for locations on an implied reference sequence.
